description: Nested full splats on a list are an error when the inner splats give tuples of different types
notes: The spec says a splat is approximately equivalent to a for expression, which would give [["x"], []] here if the second splat were nested in the first, and its grammar doesn't nest splats at all, which would give ["x", null]. hashicorp/hcl nests the second splat, builds a list for a list source, and reports an error when the inner splats give values of different types, here a one-element tuple and an empty tuple (SplatExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
